errorTitle.description: Title for generic error alert dialogs

close.description: Button label to close a modal or sheet

remove.description: Button label to remove an item

noCoverAvailable.description: Accessibility label for a book card when no cover image exists

coverAlt.description: Accessibility label for a book cover image

offlineTitle.description: Alert title shown when a library action is attempted while the device is offline

requiresConnection.description: Alert/banner body explaining that the attempted action needs an internet connection (library edits are online-only)

offlineEditNotice.description: Persistent notice on the wishlist and my-books screens while offline, explaining that the library can't be edited until back online
